notification_rule: Notify only for material new official status evidence, resolved identity conflicts or new material access blockers; unchanged evidence remains silent.
source_policy: Official UN and verified official host-government or training-institution records only. Secondary reporting may identify a lead but cannot certify completion.

watch_population.identity_hold: Possible related host programme 24 August–18 September; reconcile three-week UN component versus four-week host programme before matching. Do not import its attendance.
Require exact course and cohort; absence of a published graduation is not cancellation.
Scheduled start passing does not prove commencement.
Retain month precision until exact dates are officially established.

completion_gate: A course-specific official body explicitly states completion/graduation and its identity, dates, host and location can be reconciled. Opening or certification criteria alone are insufficient.
persistence_rule: Append material new evidence in a dated course-watch update; never rewrite frozen V5/V6 registers. Verify commit read-back before claiming persistence. Record access or write failures accurately.
stop_rule: After all eight cohorts have conclusive official dispositions, send one closing summary and disable the scheduled watch.
